Plan file created at: **`specs/chore-fa2cf018-fix-similar-outfits-flat-lay-generation.md`**

The plan outlines a 7-step implementation to fix the similar outfits flat-lay generation issue by adding proactive image generation in OutfitDetail.tsx, mirroring the pattern used in ChatAssistant.tsx. Key changes:

1. Add state management for enhanced similar outfits with pre-generated flat-lay images
2. Create a generation function that handles caching and API calls
3. Trigger proactive generation via useEffect when similar outfits change
4. Pass enhanced outfits to SimilarOutfits component (no changes needed to SimilarOutfits.tsx since it already handles pre-populated images correctly)
